title: One canvas vs many
blurb: Compares one shared 2D canvas, one shared WebGL canvas, N live per-element 2D canvases and N per-element 2D canvases with offscreen eviction and frame-budgeted painting across 8, 24, 64 and 128 controls.
question: For 8, 24, 64 and 128 live interactive controls, how do mount time, scroll smoothness, bulk theme-switch jank and estimated GPU memory compare across one shared 2D canvas, one shared WebGL canvas, N live per-element 2D canvases and N per-element 2D canvases with offscreen eviction and frame-budgeted painting?
